subject: Taxes
title: The Bible and Taxes
description: A fast breakdown of The Bible and Taxes for builders.

hook.text: 'Render unto Caesar what is Caesar's.' Jesus' famous tax quote settled whether Jews should pay Roman taxes.

buildup.text: Tax collectors—called publicans—appear throughout the Bible as symbols of corruption and greed.

discovery.text: Matthew, one of Jesus' twelve apostles, was a tax collector. His inclusion was deliberately shocking.

twist.text: The Bible doesn't oppose taxes—it opposes unjust taxation. The moral isn't 'don't pay,' it's 'collect fairly.'

climax.text: Two thousand years later, debates about fair taxation still echo the same biblical tension.

punchline.text: Render unto Caesar. Fair taxation is a 2,000-year-old debate.

quiz.question: Which apostle was a tax collector before following Jesus?
